name_jp: 第四北越フィナンシャルグループ
summary_en: FY3/27 dividend raised to 80 yen/share (intermediate 40 yen, year-end 40 yen) from prior forecast of 76 yen/share (intermediate 38 yen, year-end 38 yen). Payout ratio 40.4% against raised full-year earnings guidance. Increase driven by upward revision of net income (+6.0% to 53.0 billion yen) following earlier-than-expected June policy rate hike.
summary_jp: FY3/27通期配当を80円/株に増配（中間40円、期末40円）。前回予想76円/株（中間38円、期末38円）から引き上げ。配当性向40.4%。6月の政策金利引き上げで純利益見通しが上方修正（+6.0%、530億円）され対応。

summary_en: Policy-held stock (at market value) as % of consolidated net assets to fall below 20% by end-FY3/28, accelerated 2 years; additional target to reach below 10% set for earlier achievement. Existing ¥20B (book value) reduction through end-FY3/27 maintained.
